action.prompt:
This file is part of the Halloween decoration layer (AppHaunting, HalloweenStage, NightShiftScene, or PixelBat). Before writing or editing it, verify:

1. IMPORT CHECK: This component must not import from lib/decoders.mjs, lib/archive.mjs, lib/parity.mjs, lib/carve.mjs, lib/recovery.worker.js, or lib/session-store.js. Decoration components are read-only observers.

2. STATE CHECK: This component must not call indexedDB directly, dispatch writes to session state, or mutate any recovery data. It may only read props passed down to it.

3. EVENT COMMUNICATION: The only way this component may react to recovery events is by listening to CustomEvents on window (e.g. tls:decoded, tls:export, tls:error, tls:artifact-selected). It must never call recovery functions directly.

4. PERFORMANCE CHECK: Any new animation added must:
   - Use transform and opacity only (no width, height, top, left, margin changes)
   - Be wrapped in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)
   - Target 60 FPS

5. POINTER CHECK: Any purely decorative overlay (embers, fog, bats) must have pointer-events: none so it cannot intercept clicks on recovery controls.

If any constraint is violated, block the write and explain the fix.
